name: timeline
title: Timeline
description: Timeline built from parts on ui-sdk: vertical or horizontal events with status, colored markers, filling lines and tooltips, plus a collapsible mode that opens from a stacked summary with a staggered entrance.

files.content:
export { createTimelineController } from "@ui-sdk/react/timeline"
export { Timeline } from "./timeline"
export { TimelineCollapsible } from "./timeline-collapsible"
export { TimelineCollapsiblePanel } from "./timeline-collapsible-panel"
export { TimelineCollapsibleTrigger } from "./timeline-collapsible-trigger"
export { TimelineConnector } from "./timeline-connector"
export { TimelineContent } from "./timeline-content"
export { TimelineDescription } from "./timeline-description"
export { TimelineItem } from "./timeline-item"
export { TimelineLeader } from "./timeline-leader"
export { TimelineMarker } from "./timeline-marker"
export { TimelineStack } from "./timeline-stack"
export { TimelineStackItem } from "./timeline-stack-item"
export { TimelineTime } from "./timeline-time"
export { TimelineTitle } from "./timeline-title"
export type {
  TimelineCollapsiblePanelProps,
  TimelineCollapsibleProps,
  TimelineCollapsibleTriggerProps,
  TimelineColor,
  TimelineConnectorProps,
  TimelineContentProps,
  TimelineDescriptionProps,
  TimelineItemProps,
  TimelineLeaderProps,
  TimelineMarkerProps,
  TimelineMarkerShape,
  TimelineMarkerVariant,
  TimelineProps,
  TimelineSize,
  TimelineStackItemProps,
  TimelineStackProps,
  TimelineStatus,
  TimelineTimeProps,
  TimelineTitleProps,
  TimelineTooltipOptions,
  TimelineVariant,
} from "./timeline.types"

"use client"

import { CollapsibleTrigger } from "@ui-sdk/react/collapsible"

import { cn } from "@/lib/cn"

import type { TimelineCollapsibleTriggerProps } from "./timeline.types"
import { timelineCollapsibleTriggerClasses } from "./timeline.variants"

export function TimelineCollapsibleTrigger({ className, ...props }: TimelineCollapsibleTriggerProps) {
  return <CollapsibleTrigger className={cn(timelineCollapsibleTriggerClasses, className)} {...props} />
}

"use client"

import { Collapsible } from "@ui-sdk/react/collapsible"

import { cn } from "@/lib/cn"

import type { TimelineCollapsibleProps } from "./timeline.types"
import { timelineCollapsibleClasses } from "./timeline.variants"

export function TimelineCollapsible({ className, ...props }: TimelineCollapsibleProps) {
  return <Collapsible className={cn(timelineCollapsibleClasses, className)} {...props} />
}

"use client"

import { TimelineConnector as TimelineConnectorPart } from "@ui-sdk/react/timeline"

import { cn } from "@/lib/cn"

import type { TimelineConnectorProps } from "./timeline.types"
import { timelineConnectorClasses } from "./timeline.variants"

export function TimelineConnector({ className, ...props }: TimelineConnectorProps) {
  return <TimelineConnectorPart className={cn(timelineConnectorClasses, className)} {...props} />
}
